summary: Daktronics filed a Form 8-K covering routine items: a credit agreement amendment allowing transfer of certain non-material patents at less than fair market value; a fiscal Q1 2026 earnings press release; and a CEO base salary increase to $600,000 effective September 13, 2026 with a corresponding target incentive increase. No transaction, strategic review, or forced management departure is present. The filing also includes supplemental investor materials. This is an ordinary current report with no special-situation catalyst.
